items.comment: Could you provide a small, shareable reproducer that still triggers the “Floating point exception (core dumped)” crash? Prefer either (A) a minimal SQL script (CREATE TABLE / INSERT / the exact failing `INSERT ... SELECT` from Postgres) and any small sample data (CSV or SQL) that reproduces it, or (B) the schemas of `PostgresTable1`/`PostgresTable2` plus the exact SELECT used and the full CLI output/error text. That will let us reproduce the crash locally without confidential data.
items.label: needs reproducible example
items.rationale: The report shows a crash during `INSERT ... SELECT` from a Postgres attachment but provides neither the failing SQL (exact INSERT/SELECT) nor any table schemas or sample data. Without the query and minimal data/schema, the failure cannot be reproduced or debugged.
